summary: Eight-metre steep stub at a junction, too short and tight for a van.
reasons: Only 8 m, shorter than a van

drivers.seclusion: House 10 m away at the start, more homes 17-24 m away on the east side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane climbing from a main road corner; the stretch is under one van length and there is little clear ground beside it.
drivers.traffic: Corner of a busy through road, with a quiet lane above.
drivers.convention: One or two cars parked further up the lane; nothing to show overnight use.

flags: Noise from the main road at the corner
sun_shade: Dense trees over the east side and lane; open to the road corner on the south.
